thread:
ops-jen: Heads up — EU GPU cluster failing to finish node onboarding after the firewall/IAM rollout last night :warning:
ops-jen: Symptoms: instances boot, kubelet starts, then crashloop with decrypt/assume errors. capacity down ~22% in eu-west-1
sre-marcus: logs?
ops-jen: snippet from node-agent:
```
2026-03-20T02:18:12Z ERROR provisioning failed: KMSDecryptError: AccessDeniedException when calling the Decrypt operation
caused by: sts:AssumeRoleDenied: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/provisioner-role/instance
```
infra-eli: I see related denies in CloudTrail around 02:15-02:28 — looks like the new IAM role-boundary policy prevented the cross-account assume used by our provisioning lambda.
security-greg: That role-boundary change was intentional to lock down lateral movement. We warned infra but maybe the boundary is too strict for the provisioner principal.
sre-marcus: Quick mitigation: can we temporarily revert the boundary or add an explicit allow for the provisioner principal?
security-greg: We can add a scoped exception for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/provisioner-role` to allow `sts:AssumeRole` back to the bootstrap account for a 2-hr window. Preference: scoped allow + tight conditions.
ops-jen: For immediate capacity relief we applied the scoped exception at 02:42 — nodes started onboarding again and Ready counts climbed back after ~6 mins :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy finished — policy exception applied by security-greg at 2026-03-20T02:42:11Z
infra-eli: Follow-up: KMS key policy also rejected decrypts for model-cache artifacts when the node tried to fetch encrypted weights. Key policy needs to include the provisioning role's kms:Decrypt permission for the artifact bucket.
security-greg: Agreed. I'll open a PR to update the KMS key policy and add a test in the bootstrap pipeline to validate decrypts.
sre-marcus: We should also add a healthcheck metric that surfaces STS/KMS deny spikes — had to chase logs across CloudTrail -> node logs -> deploy pipeline.
ops-jen: Postmortem items:
- short-term: scoped sts allow (2h) applied — rollback once nodes stable
- mid-term: update role boundary + KMS policy to include provisioner conditions
- long-term: integration test for role-boundary + kms decrypt in canary pipeline
security-greg: I'll coordinate the PR and tag infra-eli. Want to get this into the next patch window (ETA 48h).
infra-eli: cost note — if we keep a more permissive exception for longer, we'll avoid spot cold-starts but increase blast radius. Ops prefers short exception + fast fix.
ops-jen: Agreed. Capacity target reached for now. Keeping this thread for follow-ups. Thanks all :eyes:
